rv.q: Catch of the Day definitely leaves you wanting more and certainly makes the saga of the Dingle sturgeon a true yarn for the ages.
It may simply be a good example of a piece developed for a local audience that doesn't travel well.
Catch of the Day is an unexpected delight.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Irish pub tale about a legendary fish catch, with some finding it gloriously droll and gleefully entertaining, while others question whether the comedy lands effectively.
